narration:1:1029771001:0.text: By the time you arrive, Rowan's well into his report, reading off the numbers.
narration:1:1029771001:0.source_cn: 你们赶到时，罗万的汇报已经开始了，正在朗读数据方面的内容。

narration:2:1029771002:0.text: The place is still packed with well-attired merchants—and among them, you spot a familiar figure...
narration:2:1029771002:0.source_cn: 周围仍然围着不少穿着光鲜的体面商人，你们在其中敏锐地发...

say:6:1029771003:1.text: Hey, you guys are right on time. Rowan's only just begun with the numbers—plenty of opportunity for a quick chat.
say:6:1029771003:1.source_cn: 嗨，你们来的挺是时候的，小少爷正在读无聊的部分呢，正好...

say:7:1029771004:1.text: Is it really necessary to read those numbers out loud in front of everyone...?
say:7:1029771004:1.source_cn: 他们秘银商会就这么公开读这些数据吗……

say:8:1029771005:1.text: Well, for one, it's a long-held tradition. The Mithril Consortium prides itself on spotless books—clean and shiny.
say:8:1029771005:1.source_cn: 一方面据说是他们的传统，体现出秘银商会那如银般洁净无瑕...

say:9:1029771006:1.text: Of course, I bet half those "public" numbers were cooked up in some shady backroom first.
say:9:1029771006:1.source_cn: 当然，我是觉得能公开的数字多半也是在某间不可告人的小黑...

choice_prompt:10:1029771006.text: Of course, I bet half those "public" numbers were cooked up in some shady backroom first.
choice_prompt:10:1029771006.source_cn: 当然，我是觉得能公开的数字多半也是在某间不可告人的小黑屋里秘密商讨出来的就是了。

say:11:1029771007:1.text: Rowan himself asked for it. With enough eyes on him, it's safer this way. Makes it harder for the shadows to strike.
say:11:1029771007:1.source_cn: 另一方面，当然是罗万少爷的亲自请求，足够公开，有足够多...

say:12:1029771008:1.text: Even with villains creeping in the dark, our young Rowan—sharp as ever, heir to the Mithril Consortium, and fiancé to the princess...
say:12:1029771008:1.source_cn: 幕后黑手是多么的阴暗，我们的罗万少爷，聪慧无比的商业奇...

say:13:1029771009:1.text: ...journeys alongside the great Magister, weaving new trade networks and accomplishing deeds so radiant they banish every shadow.
say:13:1029771009:1.source_cn: ——和伟大魔法师一起到处游玩，还顺便开拓了全新商业版图...
say:13:1029771009:1.male: ...journeys alongside the great Magister, weaving new trade networks and accomplishing deeds so radiant they banish every shadow.
say:13:1029771009:1.female: ...journeys alongside the great Magister, weaving new trade networks and accomplishing deeds so radiant they banish every shadow.

choice_prompt:14:1029771009.text: ...journeys alongside the great Magister, weaving new trade networks and accomplishing deeds so radiant they banish every shadow.
choice_prompt:14:1029771009.source_cn: ——和伟大魔法师一起到处游玩，还顺便开拓了全新商业版图的秘银商会正统继承人，就有多么的光辉灿烂。
choice_prompt:14:1029771009.male: ...journeys alongside the great Magister, weaving new trade networks and accomplishing deeds so radiant they banish every shadow.
choice_prompt:14:1029771009.female: ...journeys alongside the great Magister, weaving new trade networks and accomplishing deeds so radiant they banish every shadow.

say:15:1029771010:1.text: Duh! You were off gallivanting while someone else was stuck doing all the heavy lifting.
say:15:1029771010:1.source_cn: 那当然！有些人只顾着自己游玩，却忘记还有人勤勤恳恳地留...
say:15:1029771010:1.male: Duh! You were off gallivanting while someone else was stuck doing all the heavy lifting.
say:15:1029771010:1.female: Duh! You were off gallivanting while someone else was stuck doing all the heavy lifting.

say:16:1029771012:1.text: With the General away, every single request—trade applications, goods inspections, tourist paperwork—you name it, all ended up on my desk.
say:16:1029771012:1.source_cn: 唉，将军不在，你们提交的什么通商申请、货物审查、游客出...

say:17:1029771013:1.text: You should thank me! I let it all through because of you. Otherwise, even Rowan would've had a much harder time of it.
say:17:1029771013:1.source_cn: 我可是看在你的面子上才一路放行，否则，就算是罗万少爷亲...
say:17:1029771013:1.male: You should thank me! I let it all through because of you. Otherwise, even Rowan would've had a much harder time of it.
say:17:1029771013:1.female: You should thank me! I let it all through because of you. Otherwise, even Rowan would've had a much harder time of it.

choice_prompt:18:1029771013.text: You should thank me! I let it all through because of you. Otherwise, even Rowan would've had a much harder time of it.
choice_prompt:18:1029771013.source_cn: 我可是看在你的面子上才一路放行，否则，就算是罗万少爷亲自来，也要多走不少流程。
choice_prompt:18:1029771013.male: You should thank me! I let it all through because of you. Otherwise, even Rowan would've had a much harder time of it.
choice_prompt:18:1029771013.female: You should thank me! I let it all through because of you. Otherwise, even Rowan would've had a much harder time of it.

say:19:1029771014:1.text: Mm-hmm, I won't say "don't mention it". I earned that thank-you and a gift of gratitude.
say:19:1029771014:1.source_cn: 嗯哼，我可不会说不客气，这是我应得的感谢——别忘了给我谢礼。
say:19:1029771014:1.male: Mm-hmm, I won't say "don't mention it". I earned that thank-you and a gift of gratitude.
say:19:1029771014:1.female: Mm-hmm, I won't say "don't mention it". I earned that thank-you and a gift of gratitude.

say:20:1029771015:1.text: Okay, jokes aside—look, Rowan's about to make his move.
say:20:1029771015:1.source_cn: 啊，玩笑话先暂停，看，少爷准备动手了。
say:20:1029771015:1.male: Okay, jokes aside—look, Rowan's about to make his move.
say:20:1029771015:1.female: Okay, jokes aside—look, Rowan's about to make his move.

say:23:1029771016:0.text: ... To sum up, despite some tough obstacles on the road, our new multi-point trade network is meeting expectations. We'll continue testing it moving forward.
say:23:1029771016:0.source_cn: ——综上所述，尽管在旅途中发生了诸多艰难险阻，本次的多...

say:24:1029771017:0.text: This success wouldn't have been possible without the support and help of everyone here. Thank you.
say:24:1029771017:0.source_cn: 本次的成功少不了各位同仁一直以来的支持与援助，在此，我...

say:25:1029771018:0.text: However, I regret to report that some of the obstacles I encountered came from within our own ranks.
say:25:1029771018:0.source_cn: 但，我也很遗憾地想要告诉诸位，经过调查，我曾经遇到过的...

say:26:1029771019:1.text: There's a rot in the wood—pardon my words—but this individual stole from the company.
say:26:1029771019:1.source_cn: 有一条蛀虫——请原谅我用这样的词来形容，他不仅监守自盗...

say:27:1029771020:0.text: When I started checking the books, he panicked—and even hired outside help from rival groups to take me out.
say:27:1029771020:0.source_cn: 甚至在查账初见端倪时狗急跳墙，联络其他商会的外部人员对...

say:28:1029771021:0.text: As Rowan makes his accusation, not just the Mithril Consortium reps but the whole crowd starts murmuring...
say:28:1029771021:0.source_cn: 伴随着罗万的指控，不仅仅是秘银商会的参会者，其他围观的...

say:29:1029771022:0.text: And among them, one face shifts uncomfortably...
say:29:1029771022:0.source_cn: 而其中，有一个人的表情，分外值得注意……

cinematic_dialogue:32:1029772001:.text: Pinder! Got anything to say for yourself?!

say:34:1029771011:1.text: How thoughtful. I used to think you were deliberately showing up only when I was on duty just to give me more work.
say:34:1029771011:1.source_cn: 真是善解人意。我之前都以为你是故意趁着只有我当班的时候...
say:34:1029771011:1.male: How thoughtful. I used to think you were deliberately showing up only when I was on duty just to give me more work.
say:34:1029771011:1.female: How thoughtful. I used to think you were deliberately showing up only when I was on duty just to give me more work.

choice:14:1:2.text: You can come with us next time.
choice:14:1:2.male: You can come with us next time.
choice:14:1:2.female: You can come with us next time.
